name: vestra-slint-experimental1
description: 仅用于 Slint 实验，与最终成品 API 会有很大差异

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts tests/probes/*/*.test.ts tests/acceptance/*.test.ts tests/functional/*.test.ts tests/interactive/*.test.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check sdk runtime tests plugins tools package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --write sdk runtime tests plugins tools package.json tsconfig.json
